To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the combination of distributed redirection and centralized redirection is the most scalable approach to handle high request rates to Web servers.

(1) the combination of centralized dispatching for entire domains and distributed dispatching for individual requests is the best solution for a Web server cluster, and (2) the use of status information for the selection of servers to redirect requests to is the most effective approach to load sharing in a Web server cluster.
the combination of distributed dispatching with centralized redirection and reassignment of entire client requests is the best choice for a Web server cluster.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of load sharing algorithms for distributed Web-server systems that are based on redirection.
the development of efficient load sharing mechanisms for Web server clusters.
the development of algorithms for the redirection of user requests in a distributed Web-server system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

a Web cluster architecture with centralized and distributed dispatch is the most effective way to handle high load in a WWW environment, and the best combination of dispatching policies is centralized dispatch for domain reassignment and distributed dispatch for individual request redirection.
the combination of asynchronous and distributed redirection policies is the most efficient approach for Web server clustering, especially for high load skews and for a large number of servers.
centralized dispatching policies should be used to assign entire domains to a particular Web server.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the combination of a centralized dispatching policy for reassignment of domains and a distributed dispatching policy for individual requests is the most promising solution for load sharing in a distributed Web-server system.
the combination of a centralized and a distributed redirection algorithm is the best approach.
the centralized and distributed dispatch policies are complementary to each other.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a centralized dispatching policy should be used in conjunction with a distributed dispatching policy to achieve a high performance and scalability.
the redirection algorithms should be designed to be adaptive to the dynamic nature of the WWW environment and to the changing load conditions.
it is possible to design and implement a redirection mechanism that is both scalable and efficient.
